AUTHIMS.value: IBM Db2 for z/OS, IBM IMS DL/I
IBM CICS Transaction Server, IBM IMS TM

modules.name: Pending authorizations (IMS DB + DB2 + MQ)
modules.what_it_does: receives card authorization requests over MQ, stores pending authorizations in IMS and DB2, and lets operators view/approve them online

modules.name: Transaction type maintenance (DB2)
modules.what_it_does: maintains the transaction type/category reference tables in DB2 online and loads them in batch

modules.name: Account/date inquiry over MQ (VSAM)
modules.what_it_does: answers account and system-date inquiries arriving on MQ queues from the VSAM account files

modules.name: CardDemo core credit card application
modules.what_it_does: signs users on, maintains accounts, cards, users and transactions online (CICS/VSAM) and runs the nightly posting, interest, reporting and statement batch stream
